units.source_text: 髭黑大将急欲早日将玉鬘迎归自己邸内，正做种种准备。

en.t: General Higekuro was eager to bring Tamakazura to his own residence as soon as possible and was making all sorts of preparations.

units.source_text: 但源氏认为玉鬘倘毫不介意，贸然迁往，

en.t: But Genji thought that if Tamakazura took no notice of the matter and moved there rashly,

units.source_text: 则心怀醋意的正夫人正在那边等候她，对她甚是不利。

en.t: the jealous principal wife would be waiting for her there, which would be very disadvantageous for her.

units.source_text: 便以此为由，对髭黑大将说道：

en.t: Using this as his reason, he said to General Higekuro:

units.source_text: “我劝你还得镇静些，慢慢地来，

en.t: I advise you to remain a little calmer and proceed slowly,

units.source_text: 不可张扬，务使你们两人都不受人讥议与怨恨。”

en.t: without making it public, so that neither of you will incur criticism or resentment from others.

units.source_text: 内大臣私下对人说道：

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said privately to others:

units.source_text: “我看如此反而安稳。

en.t: To my mind, this is actually safer.

units.source_text: 她没有特别关切的保护人，草草地入宫去度豪华的生涯，

en.t: She has no protector who is especially devoted to her, and if she carelessly entered the palace to live a splendid life,

units.source_text: 处境定多痛苦，我很替她担心。

en.t: her position would surely bring much suffering, and I am very worried for her.

units.source_text: 我固然有心提拔她；

en.t: Of course, I do wish to advance her prospects;

units.source_text: 然而弘徽殿女御正在承宠，教我如何下手呢？”

en.t: but Lady Kokiden is now enjoying the Emperor's favor, so how could I possibly intervene?

units.source_text: 这话说得有理：

en.t: There was reason in these words:

units.source_text: 身在帝侧，而恩宠不及别人，只当一个寻常宫女，

en.t: to be at the Emperor's side, yet receive less favor than others and remain merely an ordinary court lady,

units.source_text: 不为帝所重视，毕竟是不幸的。

en.t: without being valued by the Emperor, is after all an unhappy fate.

units.source_text: 新婚第三日之夜，举行祝贺仪式，

en.t: On the third night after the wedding, a congratulatory ceremony was held,

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣与新夫妇唱和诗歌，备极欢洽。

en.t: and Genji, the Grand Minister, exchanged poems with the newly married couple in the happiest harmony.

units.source_text: 内大臣闻此消息，方知源氏抚养玉鬘，确是一片好意，

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior heard this news, he finally understood that Genji had raised Tamakazura out of genuine goodwill,

units.source_text: 心中不胜感激。

en.t: and in his heart he was deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 这件婚事虽然办得十分秘密，但世人自会知道，并感兴趣。

en.t: Although this marriage had been arranged in great secrecy, people naturally came to know of it and took an interest.

units.source_text: 辗转流传，变成了一件珍闻，轰动一时。

en.t: As the story passed from mouth to mouth, it became a rare piece of news and caused a stir for a time.

units.source_text: 不久冷泉帝也闻知了。

en.t: Before long, Emperor Reizei also heard of it.

units.source_text: 他说：“可惜啊！这个人与我没有宿缘。

en.t: He said, What a pity! This woman and I had no destined bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 但既有为尚侍之志，不妨依旧入宫。

en.t: But since she has the intention of becoming Naishi no Kami, there is no harm in her entering the palace as before.

units.source_text: 尚侍不比女御、更衣，已嫁之人亦无不可。”

en.t: Naishi no Kami is not the same as a consort or a lower-ranking imperial lady, so even a married woman would not be unsuitable.
